references.text: Moses, the servant of the Lord, died in the land of Moab, as the Lord had said.
The Lord told Moses that his death was near and commanded him to call Joshua.
Joshua was appointed as Moses' successor by the laying on of hands.
The promise to cross the Jordan and take possession of the land the Lord gives them.
Israel will cross the Jordan to take possession of the land the Lord gives them.
The fulfillment of the command to cross the Jordan with all the people.
Moses is referred to as the servant of the Lord.
Joshua was filled with the spirit of wisdom and took over leadership after Moses.
Reference to Joshua leading the people into rest in the promised land.
Stephen mentions that the fathers brought the ark of the covenant into the land under Joshua.
